basis: The root asserts a conditional comparison between cross-sections of Venus and Earth.
children: If we could slice Venus and Earth in half, pole to pole, and place them side by side, they would look remarkably similar.
scoped_obligations: The conditional antecedent describes a hypothetical action.
The conditional consequent describes a visual comparison.
The scope of 'remarkably similar' applies to the visual comparison of the cross-sections.
